model.embedded_preprocessing: 11 code-type columns are passed through learned embeddings; the 12 numeric columns are used as delivered by the shared pre-processing pipeline

dataset.version_or_hash: sha256 of row fingerprints (cache/h.npy), first 16 chars: 5f4d9555fd0eb1ec
dataset.feature_order_or_schema: src_port, dst_port, proto, service, duration, src_bytes, dst_bytes, conn_state, missed_bytes, src_pkts, src_ip_bytes, dst_pkts, dst_ip_bytes, dns_qclass, dns_qtype, dns_rcode, dns_AA, dns_RD, dns_RA, dns_rejected, http_request_body_len, http_response_body_len, http_status_code
dataset.fixed_test_split_id: 5-fold, duplicate-safe, stratified by attack type, seed 42, fold fingerprint f685e73660f2e42d; metrics pooled over the 5 held-out folds

environment.device: CPU: AMD64 Family 23 Model 96 Stepping 1, AuthenticAMD
environment.hardware_notes: AMD Ryzen 7 4700U, 8 logical processors, 7.4 GB RAM, AMD Radeon integrated graphics (not used), laptop on mains power

roc_auc.score_source: sigmoid of the network output, pooled out-of-fold

pr_auc.score_source: sigmoid of the network output, pooled out-of-fold

inference.measurement_notes: Fixed set of 200,000 rows (first rows of fold 0's held-out part, not the full test set). Latency per example = pass time / rows; mean, p50 and p95 are taken over the 10 timed passes. Data already in memory. training_seconds is the sum of 5 fold trainings.

complexity.architecture: 11 embedding tables + concat with 12 numeric inputs -> Linear 128 -> ReLU -> Linear 64 -> ReLU -> Linear 1

limitations_or_failure_reason: The shared pre-processing was fitted on all 23 files, including rows that are test rows here; a final evaluation should split first and refit on training rows only.
Folds keep rows with identical predictor values together, but similar (not identical) flows from the same attack session can still sit in different folds.
The data is stored sorted by attack type and some types are rare (mitm: 1,052 rows), so per-type results are noisy.
A fixed decision threshold of 0.5 was used; no tuning.
Inference timing used a fixed subset, not the full test set; peak memory was not measured.
This measures clean accuracy, not adversarial robustness.
notes: Metrics are pooled over the 5 held-out folds, so every row is predicted exactly once.
